## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup


packages <- c("here", "sf", "rnaturalearth", "tidyverse")

missing <- packages[!packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing) > 0) install.packages(missing)

invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

## Read zip files, load data

```{r}
#| label: read-data

# Spalten, die behalten werden sollen
keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
          "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
          "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

# Liest die Halbstunden-Daten aus EINER FLUXNET-ZIP-Datei
read_fluxnet_hh <- function(zip_file, keep, exdir = here("data", "raw", "unzipped")) {
  site_id <- regmatches(basename(zip_file),
                        regexpr("[A-Z]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]{3}", basename(zip_file)))
  hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
  unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = exdir)

  read_csv(file.path(exdir, hh_name),
           na = "-9999",
           col_select = any_of(keep),
           col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d")) |>
    mutate(time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
           site = site_id,
           .before = 1)
}

zip_files <- list.files(here("data", "raw"), pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)
hh <- lapply(zip_files, read_fluxnet_hh, keep = keep) |> bind_rows()

count(hh, site)
```

## Section 1: Site overview

```{r}
#| label: section_1
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#1. load snapshot-file

snap_file <- list.files(here("data", "snapshots"),
                        pattern = "^fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE) |> sort() |> tail(1)   

snap <- read_csv(snap_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

#create table with information on towers

tower_table <- snap %>%
  filter(site_id %in% hh$site) %>%
  select(
    Site_ID = site_id,
    name = site_name,
    IGBP = igbp,
    latitude = location_lat,
    longitude = location_long,
    first_year = first_year,
    last_year = last_year,
    hub = data_hub, 
    citation = product_citation
  ) %>%
  mutate(country = substr(Site_ID, 1,2))

  

#map of tower sites

world <- ne_countries(scale ="small", returnclass = "sf")

towers_sf <- st_as_sf(tower_table,
                      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                      crs = 4326)

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey80", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = towers_sf, color = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_sf_text(data = towers_sf, aes(label = Site_ID), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Locations of the five FLUXNET Towers") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Section 2: Data availability

```{r}
#| label: section_2


data_avail <- hh %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(time, "%Y"))) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_halfhours = n(),
    share_measured = mean(coalesce(NEE_VUT_REF_QC == 0, FALSE)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#top 10 site-year combinations with most available data
data_avail %>% arrange(desc(share_measured)) %>% head(10)

#heat map

ggplot(data = data_avail, aes(x = year, y = site, fill = share_measured)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0,1),
                       labels = scales::percent,
                       name = "Measured NEE") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(data_avail$year), max(data_avail$year), by = 2)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL,
       title = "Share of half hours with measured NEE (QC = 0)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Result: Us-Mo3 has the shortest but best covered NEE Measurements. The best year is 2020.

## Section 3: Data summary

```{r}
#| label: section_3
vars <- c("TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F", "NEE_VUT_REF",
          "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF", "H_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS")

units <- c(
  TA_F            = "°C",
  SW_IN_F         = "W m-2",
  VPD_F           = "hPa",
  P_F             = "mm; Mittel = mittl. Jahressumme mm a-1",
  NEE_VUT_REF     = "gC m-2 d-1",
  GPP_NT_VUT_REF  = "gC m-2 d-1",
  RECO_NT_VUT_REF = "gC m-2 d-1",
  H_F_MDS         = "W m-2",
  LE_F_MDS        = "W m-2"
)


hh <- hh %>%
  mutate(year = year(time))


#define function to crate table with basic statistics

make_table <- function(d){
  tab <- d %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(vars), list(
      mean    = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      min     = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      max     = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      missing = ~ mean(is.na(.x)) * 100
    ))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = c("variable", "stat"),
                 names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|min|max|missing)$") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value)



#Precipitation
p_annual <- d %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    p_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm=T)) %>%
  pull(p_sum) %>%
  mean()

tab$P_F[tab$stat == "mean"] <- p_annual

#add units to values
tab %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, " [", units[.x], "]"), all_of(vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))


}


#one table per site:
site_tables <- lapply(split(hh, hh$site), make_table)

site_tables$`US-Mo3`
site_tables$`IT-SR2`
site_tables$`CZ-wet`
site_tables$`CN-Xi2`
site_tables$`AU-Whr`
```

## Section 4: Time series

```{r}
#| label: section_4

flux_vars <- c("NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

daily <- hh %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(time)) %>%
  group_by(site, date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)),               # number valid half-hours
    across(all_of(flux_vars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(flux_vars), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))

daily_long <- daily %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(flux_vars), names_to = "flux", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(flux = recode(flux,
                       NEE_VUT_REF     = "NEE",
                       GPP_NT_VUT_REF  = "GPP",
                       RECO_NT_VUT_REF = "RECO"))

ggplot(daily_long, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = flux)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(NEE = "black", GPP = "#1b9e77", RECO = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = expression("Flux [g C m"^-2*" d"^-1*"]"),
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Section 5: Diurnal cycles

```{r}
#| label: section_5

site_lat <- tower_table %>%
  select(site = Site_ID, lat = latitude) %>%
  filter(site %in% unique(hh$site))


diurnal <- hh %>%
  left_join(site_lat, by = "site") %>%
  mutate(
    month     = month(time),
    # southern hemisphere: shift month by 6
    month_adj = if_else(lat < 0, (month + 5) %% 12 + 1, month),
    season    = case_when(
      month_adj %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month_adj %in% 3:5         ~ "Spring",
      month_adj %in% 6:8         ~ "Summer",
      month_adj %in% 9:11        ~ "Autumn"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")),
    hour   = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60      # 0, 0.5, 1, ..., 23.5
  )

diurnal_mean <- diurnal %>%
  group_by(site, season, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
    LE  = mean(LE_F_MDS,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NEE, LE), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable,
                           levels = c("NEE", "LE"),
                           labels = c("NEE [µmol CO2 m-2 s-1]", "LE [W m-2]")))

ggplot(diurnal_mean, aes(x = hour, y = value, colour = site)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ season, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Hour of day (local standard time)", y = NULL, colour = "Site") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside")
```

Seasons were defined as meteorological seasons based on calendar months (Spring: MAM, Summer: JJA, Autumn: SON, Winter: DJF for the northern hemisphere). For sites in the southern hemisphere (latitude \< 0°), months were shifted by six months before assigning seasons, so that e.g. January is classified as summer and July as winter. The mean diurnal course was computed by averaging all half-hourly values per site, season and time of day.

## Section 6: Your reading

```{r}
#| label: section_6

hh %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(NETRAD = mean(!is.na(NETRAD)) * 100,
            G      = mean(!is.na(G_F_MDS)) * 100)

eb_site <- "US-Mo3"

eb <- hh %>%
  filter(site == eb_site,
         H_F_MDS_QC == 0,          # nur gemessene H-Werte
         LE_F_MDS_QC == 0) %>%     # nur gemessene LE-Werte
  mutate(turb  = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS,
         avail = NETRAD - G_F_MDS) %>%
  filter(!is.na(turb), !is.na(avail))

fit   <- lm(turb ~ avail, data = eb)
slope <- coef(fit)[["avail"]]
r2    <- summary(fit)$r.squared

ggplot(eb, aes(x = avail, y = turb)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           label = sprintf("slope = %.2f\nR² = %.2f\nn = %d", slope, r2, nrow(eb))) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = expression(R[n] - G ~ "[W m"^-2*"]"),
       y = expression(H + LE ~ "[W m"^-2*"]"),
       title = paste("Energy balance closure –", eb_site)) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: section_6_2

annual <- daily %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(n_days = sum(!is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)),
            across(all_of(flux_vars), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_days >= 360) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n(),
            across(all_of(flux_vars), mean))   # mittlere Jahressumme in g C m-2 a-1

annual %>% arrange(NEE_VUT_REF)
```

```{r}
#| label: section_6_3

seasonal <- daily %>%
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>%
  group_by(site, month) %>%
  summarise(NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
            GPP = mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(amp_NEE = max(NEE) - min(NEE),
            amp_GPP = max(GPP) - min(GPP))
```

```{r}
#| label: section_6_4
gapfill <- hh %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(across(c(NEE_VUT_REF_QC, H_F_MDS_QC, LE_F_MDS_QC),
                   ~ mean(.x > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100))
```

Averaged over all complete years, AU-Whr is the strongest carbon sink with a mean annual NEE of −370 g C m⁻² a⁻¹, followed by US-Mo3 (−307 g C m⁻² a⁻¹) and IT-SR2 (−250 g C m⁻² a⁻¹). IT-SR2 has by far the largest gross fluxes (GPP ≈ 2620, RECO ≈ 2370 g C m⁻² a⁻¹), roughly twice those of the other sites, but because respiration offsets most of the uptake, its net sink is only intermediate. The largest seasonal cycle is found at US-Mo3, where the monthly mean NEE varies by 7.1 g C m⁻² d⁻¹ (GPP: 11.8 g C m⁻² d⁻¹), whereas AU-Whr shows the smallest amplitude (1.4 g C m⁻² d⁻¹) despite being the strongest annual sink, indicating that its uptake is spread fairly evenly throughout the year. The most surprising result is CZ-wet, which acts as a net carbon source (+80 g C m⁻² a⁻¹ over 19 years) because ecosystem respiration exceeds GPP, although wetlands are often expected to accumulate carbon. The result for CN-Xi2 (−153 g C m⁻² a⁻¹) should be treated with caution, as it is based on only two complete years. A large share of the data is gap-filled: between 42 % (US-Mo3) and 66 % (IT-SR2) of the half-hourly NEE values, compared with 13–27 % for H and 22–38 % for LE. The higher gap fraction for NEE mainly reflects the additional filtering of night-time periods with low turbulence (u\* filtering). Annual carbon budgets therefore depend strongly on the gap-filling algorithm and carry considerable uncertainty.
